messages:
support-jen: FYI customer ACME reporting bulk index failures after yesterday's embed model swap. Indexer rejecting insert with dim mismatch and customers seeing latency spikes + billing anomalies. Ticket #5472. Pasting logs below.

lucas: can you drop the error lines?

support-jen: ```
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z indexer ERROR vector_insert: rejected batch_id=ab12 reason=dimension_mismatch expected=1024 got=1536 rows=128 req_id=ix-req-99
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z embed-frontend WARN model-resolver: serving model rwd/embed-v2.1-quant (dim=1536) -> previously rwd/embed-v1 (dim=1024)
2026-03-15T10:12:35Z billing WARN duplicate_insert_detected customer=acme inserts=3 failed=128
```

lucas: looks like the serving swap exposed a model with a new output dim. indexer schema still expects 1024.

eng-ml-raj: Correct — v2.1-quant was promoted last night to reduce cost/latency but dim change slipped through the deploy manifest check. Options: rollback traffic to v1 (fast), add an on-the-fly projection to 1024 (temporary, lossy), or migrate vecdb schema to 1536 + full recompute/backfill.

marta: indexer intentionally rejects mismatched dims to protect downstream accuracy. We can short-circuit to drop batches and emit metric, but that doesn't fix billing noise. Need to stop retries counting as billable inserts.

opsbot: :warning: Alert: indexer-rejects spike for acme-service (count=450) window=5m policy=throttle_5m

support-jen: Customer also reporting latency spikes due to retries and duplicate billing rows showing up on invoice. They're asking for immediate mitigation.

lucas: immediate mitigation: route acme traffic to embed-v1 in us-east-1 and pause customer backfill jobs. eng-platform-olivia can you flip routing for the customer?

eng-platform-olivia: on it. Pushing a canary rollback for customer=acme -> embed-v1 in us-east-1. Will flip in ~5m and set backfill rate-limit to 1rps.

support-jen: ACME agreed to rollback window while we investigate. Planning backfill.

eng-ml-raj: Proposed conservative backfill (recompute embeddings with v2.1 and migrate vecdb dims to 1536) — this is safest for semantic parity. Alternatively, a projection utility for quick recovery: `tools/project_embeddings.py` (lossy). I'll prepare recompute job; jobs will be chunked and idempotent.

support-jen: paste the conservative backfill steps so ops can run dry-run first.

eng-ml-raj: ```bash
# conservative backfill run (dry-run first)
python jobs/recompute_embeddings.py \n  --customer acme \n  --model rwd/embed-v2.1-quant \n  --batch-size 64 \n  --rate-limit 0.5rps \n  --dry-run

# validate inserts before mark-complete
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://indexer.internal/validate?customer=acme"
```

marta: Billing team — please reconcile ACME charges and mark failed-inserts as non-billable until we resolve. @billing-team this is urgent.

billing-team: acknowledged, started a reconciliation snapshot for customer=acme. Will isolate failed-insert line-items and propose credit.

lucas: I'll open a tiny preflight PR that checks model manifest dim against indexer expected dim and returns a clear `400_DIM_MISMATCH` to clients rather than allowing a downstream failure. Also adding a metric for `embed.dim_mismatch` so SRE can alert earlier.

eng-ml-raj: also adding a CI check to fail deploys if manifest.dim != canonical_dim for that model family.

opsbot: deploybot: rollback completed for acme routing -> embed-v1 (deploy id: rb-20260315-12)

support-jen: Customer reports errors dropped after rollback. Keeping ticket open until backfill + billing reconciliation complete. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

lucas: noted. I'll take the preflight patch and add unit tests.

marta: I'll instrument a dim-mismatch alert (threshold >10/min) and add runbook entry.

support-jen: leaving action items: 1) billing reconcile (billing-team) 2) preflight PR (lucas) 3) CI deploy manifest check (eng-ml-raj) 4) backfill dry-run + phased roll (eng-ml-raj + eng-platform-olivia) 5) metric + alert (marta).

support-jen: closing loop: rollback at 10:20Z reduced errors to near zero, customer accepts phased backfill. Will update ticket #5472 with timeline and postmortem notes once backfill completes.

lucas: :eyes: starting PR now.

marta: will author the runbook update after backfill validation.

support-jen: thanks everyone.
